text:
Vik Singh: Heads-up: p50/p95 look fine but p99 on the latency dashboard for /v1/embed has been hopping around. Endpoint breakdown p99 is flat. Timeline aligns. Anyone with quick ideas?

Maya Ortiz: Common causes: merged-sketch (tdigest) rollups vs raw per-backend samples, retries being included in one view and excluded in the other, or a routing fallback that briefly took ~1-3% traffic.

Theo Park: Also check smoothing/bucket alignment. If the overview chart uses a 1m smoothing window and endpoint pane is showing raw 10s buckets you can see apparent misalignment.

Vik Singh: Query I ran: `/metrics?svc=embed&agg=percentile(99)&window=10m&bucket=10s&merge=tdigest` Endpoint pane uses `source=backend_raw&retry_filter=exclude`.

Maya Ortiz: There it is. retries filtered in endpoint. If retries land on a slower replica, merged rollup that includes retries will show a tail but endpoint won't.

Theo Park: UX suggestion: add a compact "provenance" badge beside each percentile with three micro-flags: retries?, origins, sample_count. Hover -> small flyout that explains what was included and offers a quick "Compare raw vs merged" action.

Vik Singh: Love the flyout idea. The compare action should run an internal-only query that returns both p99 numbers and an estimated cost for raw-sample retrieval.

Maya Ortiz: API debate: expose /internal/telemetry/percentile_provenance?svc=...&start=... that returns bucket-level provenance (strings only). Fields: bucket_ts, ingress_count, backend_count, fallback_count, retries_included, merge_method. Keep it internal.

Theo Park: Telemetry: schedule a daily drift job that synthesizes 1% slow-fanout and computes merged_sketch_p99 vs raw_p99; alert if delta > 12% for 3 consecutive runs. That will catch weighting/sketch issues.

infra-bot: telemetry job "p99_provenance_drift" created, runs daily at 05:15 UTC.

Vik Singh: Also propose a small "Why did my p99 change?" flyout accessible from chart. It should list likely causes in order: routing weight change, quota fallback, retries inclusion, bucket alignment, sketch compression, low sample counts. Each cause links to the relevant logs/traces/runbook.

Maya Ortiz: From implementation: two mitigations for tdigest underweighting tails: (1) temporarily increase sketch precision when total sample_count < threshold, (2) compute per-shard p99 and apply an origin-aware correction. Both have CPU/cost tradeoffs. We can start with a detection+annotation approach before changing sketches.

Theo Park: Rollout plan: feature-flag the badge+flyout + compare action internal-only. Add a canary deploy for console changes and the provenance API behind ff. Add a telemetry test (synthetic slow fanout) to the canary suite.

canary-bot: canary deploy "console/provenance-flyout-v1" started at 1829991265 :rocket:

Vik Singh: Nice. If we ship the badge and the flyout behind FF this week it should reduce noisy pages and make RCA faster. I'll draft the runbook snippet: 1) open flyout -> 2) run compare -> 3) check routing/quotas -> 4) open traces -> 5) file ticket. Short and sweet.

Maya Ortiz: I'll mock tooltip copy and add the API RFC. Theo, can you add the telemetry check as an alert and a canary test?

Theo Park: Yep, adding both. Also will make sure all consoles use UTC-aligned buckets to avoid alignment drift.

Vik Singh: Thanks team. Tag me when the canary is green and I'll brief oncall. :thumbsup:
